# COG Multispectral Small

A tiny four-band uint16 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (blue, green, red, NIR): internally tiled with one overview level and a sentinel NoData of 0.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `cog_multispectral_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("cog_multispectral_small")

    data = geocase_case.load()

```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase recognises a tiled, overview-bearing multispectral GeoTIFF as COG-structured while preserving band order and NoData.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
- [`not_tiled`](../risk/not-tiled.md)
- [`overviews_missing`](../risk/overviews-missing.md)
